item.title: Sun in Aquarius: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Sun in Aquarius means the Sun was in Aquarius when you were born. In astrology the Sun stands for your core self; Aquarius is an air sign ruled by Saturn, with Uranus as its modern ruler, fresh and independent. You see the pattern, question the rule, befriend the exception. Read more at astralroots.app
